plan.title: Live RFQ Withdrawal Blocked During Submission

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ instead of creating or searching for another event.
Enable eRFX projects as required for the live RFQ.
Apply the tenant configuration that removes Withdraw from event menus.
Apply the setting under test so withdrawal is blocked during live submission.
Apply the additional case configuration for vendor masking.
Navigate to the RFQ stage named in the case.
Open the Responses tab required by the scenario.
Assert that the live RFQ Settings menu does not offer Withdraw while the configured restriction applies.
